name: Hantech
summary: Hantech Co., Ltd., a South Korean enterprise, specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of equipment for chemical processes, various storage tanks, and cryogenic vessels. Its extensive product range encompasses static machinery like heat exchangers, reactors, pressure vessels, towers, columns, and other specialized industrial components. The company also supplies an array of tanks, including cryogenic, low-temperature, and spherical designs, alongside casks and containment units for low and intermediate-level radioactive waste. Furthermore, Hantech produces items for the green energy sector. Established in 1973, the firm's main operations are located in Ulsan, South Korea, operating as a subsidiary of Foosung Co., Ltd.
